opening.argument: The video walks viewers through creating and securing an OKX account while presenting ordinary referral and promotional rewards. The narration explains that using the referral number can bring ten dollars after registration and describes a mystery-box reward for inviting a friend, with both participants receiving a box. It also guides viewers through identity checks, including entering identification details and taking a picture of an ID card, before instructing them to set authentication. These steps involve financial-account registration and personal-data submission, so the claims and external destination warrant separate verification. But the available material does not establish that OKX or the advertised rewards are deceptive, or that viewers are being defrauded.
